info.description: The result of last-touch attribution when a referred user completes signup. One-shot: `referredUser` is unique, so a user cannot be re-attributed to a different affiliate after their account exists.

referralLinkClick.description: The specific click row that won last-touch attribution. Audit trail.

attributionIpHash.description: IP hash at attribution time (signup). Never exposed. Used only for post-hoc fraud clustering.

status.description: active = normal. blocked = admin flagged the referral as fraudulent (no future commission would fire once commission engine ships). churned = referred user hasn't logged in for a long time (populated by a future cron).
